images.title: Half of a quarter
images.purpose: Show 1/2 of 1/4 is 1/8 by cutting a shaded quarter of the unit square into two equal parts.
images.composition: One large unit square in the centre with a small caption beneath, wide white margins.
exact_structure: One unit square split by 3 vertical lines into 4 equal columns, then by 1 horizontal line across the whole square into 2 rows: 8 equal cells.
The left column (2 cells) has a light teal #0072B2 fill: this is 1/4.
The top cell of the left column is filled reddish purple #CC79A7: this is 1 of the 8 cells.
Square outline dark #2B2B2B, inner lines grey #6B7280.
rejection: purple cell outside the left column
images.takeaway: Half of a quarter is one of 8 equal parts of the whole, 1/8.
images.description: A unit square cut into 8 equal cells with the left column teal and its top cell purple.
images.context: Shown beside the concept text and video.
images.teaching_notes: Count the 8 cells, then see the purple cell is half of the teal quarter.

image_decisions.why: A unit square model is the core of the concept.
